themes.description: Develop the ability to analyze arguments, construct logical reasoning, evaluate claims critically, and express nuanced opinions. Learn vocabulary and structures for logical reasoning, critical analysis, and advanced argumentation — essential for academic, professional, and intellectual discourse in Spanish.

Develop the ability to manage international teams, resolve cross-cultural conflicts, and adapt leadership styles to different cultural contexts.

themes.title: Philosophical Discourse & Ethics
themes.description: Explore the vocabulary and grammar needed for philosophical discourse, ethical reasoning, and moral philosophy. Learn to express abstract concepts, analyze ethical dilemmas, and engage in nuanced philosophical debates in Spanish. This theme covers epistemology, metaphysics, ethics, existentialism, and the philosophical frameworks used to discuss fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, and meaning.

themes.title: Scientific Literacy & Data Analysis
themes.description: Develop the vocabulary and structures needed to discuss scientific data, interpret statistical results, and engage in evidence-based arguments. Learn to read, analyze, and communicate scientific information effectively in Spanish.

themes.title: Type 2 Conditionals — Si + Imperfect Subjunctive + Conditional
themes.description: Express hypothetical or unlikely situations in the present or future — the realm of dreams, advice, and counterfactual statements.

themes.title: Type 3 Conditionals — Si + Pluperfect Subjunctive + Conditional Perfect
themes.description: Express hypothetical situations in the past that did NOT happen — regrets, missed opportunities, and alternate histories.
